name: talend-etl
description: Complete working knowledge of Talend / Qlik Talend data integration for Claude Code: Talend Studio (Standard, Big Data Spark, ESB Routes and Services, Data Quality, MDM), the full connector library at parameter level, tMap and expression semantics, routines, build and deployment options (standalone, TAC/JobServer, Talend Cloud TMC/Remote Engine, Talend Runtime, Docker, CI Builder), the TMC/MetaServlet/CommandLine/Component Kit APIs, .item/.properties/Jobscript/export formats, version and licensing history, and a design-pattern and troubleshooting playbook. Includes offline Python helpers to inspect job .item files and exported job zips, encode TAC MetaServlet calls and talk to the Talend Cloud API.
